criteria.requirement: Old project state defaults Y axis Speed to off.
The setting round-trips in project state without changing XY points.
Right-click opens the toggle and does not record, clear, or move a trajectory.
With the toggle off, X-only XY output remains baseline-equivalent.
Centre Y maps to 1.0 and leaves the X-derived increment unchanged.
Bottom Y maps to 0.5 and top Y maps to 2.0.
Forward and reverse signed X increments retain their direction under Y scaling.
X hold and micro-loop behaviour are unchanged by Y speed.
Stereo uses the same scaled reading position for both channels.
X retrigger timing is unchanged; an X-retrigger plus Y-ramp comparison is captured.
Endpoint and abrupt Y changes remain finite and use existing transitions.
No history, seek, loop, and stop safely fall back without invalid reads.
Depth zero and bypass preserve their existing semantics.
No realtime allocation, lock, ValueTree, file IO, or logging is introduced.
check: diff review and existing realtime tests

criteria.requirement: Existing 18-condition performance thresholds are unchanged and no BRAVO or latency scope changes occur.
Focused regressions and Windows CI pass on one source before any manual bundle is produced.
